Escrow and a referral graph stop bulk fakes. A newcomer posts 40 units, names a sponsor, earning over a long horizon; the chain exposes farms as one cluster.

Newcomers earn slowly, escrow locked 20 epochs, while a rising tide of fakes breaks. Peers may flag disputes; two freeze it pending audit.

1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 units, most burned; clusters rest on shale; one audit burns the farm. Honest agents pay 40 once, refunded.
